title: Social Bias in Large Language Models For Bangla: An Empirical Study on Gender and Religious Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Template-based probing for role prediction using adjective and occupation templates, and naturally sourced probing via fill-in-the-blank tasks on paired sentences with altered gender identities (male/female).

Template-based probing for religious identity prediction using adjective and occupation templates, and naturally sourced probing via fill-in-the-blank tasks on paired sentences with altered religious identities (Hindu/Muslim).
